title: Hybrid Airship with Solar-Electric Propulsion and Vectored Thrust
abstract: A 150m hybrid airship with 200kW solar cells, four vectored electric propulsors, enabling 50-tonne payload at 120 km/h zero emissions.
claims: Multi-layer envelope (Tedlar/Mylar/Kevlar) with CIGS solar cells on 60% upper surface.
Four 200kW vectored electric propulsors with 120-degree thrust vectoring.
Lifting body hull with L/D ratio 8:1 at 120 km/h cruise.
problem_statement: Cargo transport is 8% of global CO2. Airships offer 10x lower energy per tonne-km.
